required_controls: Generic gap/sufficiency retrieval at equal calls and tokens
ToC/REFUEL-inspired interpretation enumeration and scope pruning
Same automatically generated hypotheses and candidate evidence
Relation-aware coverage, not unary token coverage only
Independent candidate proposal recall and extraction-attachment accuracy
Competent fixed reader; separate reader and retrieval factors
Natural held-out histories separate from development and authored stress cases
rejection_conditions: Conventional structure plus competent reader solves the issue
Generic sufficiency or interpretation enumeration matches specialized selection
Gold metadata or labels are needed at inference
Reliable independent natural comparison labels cannot be collected

limitations: Long search queries sometimes returned irrelevant results despite domain preferences
One potentially direct new lead remains inaccessible
Method contrasts are interpretations of inspected sections, not reproduction results
